name: Day Camp @ Eisner
operator_name: Union for Reform Judaism (URJ Eisner Camp)
description_short: A Jewish day camp for children aged 4 through rising 2nd graders, held on the grounds of URJ Eisner Camp in Great Barrington, MA. Campers use the overnight camp's pools, fields, arts center, farm and lake, and each day includes lunch and Jewish activities. Hours are 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
special_needs_notes: Campers must be fully potty trained and have the immunizations required by Massachusetts. The camp pays special attention to children with allergies and limited diets, and the whole camp is peanut and tree nut aware. Lunch is Kosher-style.
swim_waterfront_notes: There are two heated swimming pools and a lake on site. The page says swim staff get American Red Cross lifeguard training.

warnings: The page gives conflicting season years. The table is headed 'Session 2027 Dates', but the text says 'seven week-long sessions for Summer 2026' and gives the age cutoff as 'by June 29, 2026'. The dates fall Monday to Friday in 2027 (June 28, 2027 is a Monday), so I recorded them as 2027. Confirm with the camp.

One 'Register Now' link uses a 2023 email tracking tag (campintouch.com). I recorded the camp's own register/login page instead.
The administrative office phone (201-722-0400) is different from the camp phone (413-528-1652).
Eligibility: the page says campers come from families living year-round or seasonally in the southern Berkshire region of MA and NY.
